unit.why: A short memorate: R. Shalom of Belz recounts how the Seer of Lublin taught him to read petitions (kvitlach) and showed him one man's soul-root and past incarnations, followed by a description of the Seer's habit with such notes; it is minimal but has a narrated event.
unit.boundary_note: Second numbered item in a series on the Seer of Lublin's levels and ways of worship.

stories.start_quote: נודע כי הגה"ק מו"ה שלום מבעלזא
stories.end_quote: לבעל יראה בגנות של בני אדם
stories.summary_en: R. Shalom of Belz relates that the Seer of Lublin taught him to read people's kvitlach, showing him in one note the man's soul-root back to Cain or Abel, his reincarnations, sins, merits and fortune; the Seer would dwell on notes of the pious but quickly put aside those of sinners, fearing to see the faults of others.
